about: Planted defects built from examples/classic and examples/pqc. Each one states the result PQ-Proof must give. run_mutations.py applies them in a temp folder, runs the tool, and compares. A mutation whose setup cannot be applied is SKIP, and SKIP is never counted as PASS.
about_ko: examples/classic·pqc 에서 만든 심어 둔 결함. 각 항목에 PQ-Proof가 반드시 내야 할 결과를 적었다. run_mutations.py 가 임시 폴더에 적용하고 도구를 돌려 비교한다. 준비를 못 한 항목은 SKIP 이고 SKIP 은 PASS 로 세지 않는다.

mutations.title: control: examples/classic against examples/pqc (the migration done right)
mutations.title_ko: 대조군: examples/classic → examples/pqc(제대로 된 전환)

mutations.title: control: examples/classic on both sides (nothing migrated)
mutations.title_ko: 대조군: 양쪽 모두 examples/classic(전환 안 함)

mutations.title: trust-all TrustManager added to the converted Java code
mutations.title_ko: 전환본 Java에 모든 인증서를 믿는 TrustManager

mutations.title: signature verify() body replaced by return true
mutations.title_ko: 서명 verify() 몸통을 return true 로
mutations.note: Review grade by design: the verdict stays pass, r-review is review, the line is listed, and the verdict line counts the removed verifications ('2 removed verifications need review' here: the dropped call and the body that only returns success) (0.1.0; before that the pass was silent).
mutations.note_ko: 설계상 검토 등급이다. 판정은 통과로 남지만 r-review 는 검토 필요이고 줄이 목록에 나오며, 판정 줄에 '검증 호출 제거 n건 검토 필요'(여기서는 빠진 호출과 성공만 돌려주는 몸통 2건)가 붙는다(0.1.0부터. 그 전에는 말없는 통과였다).

golden: tests/golden/verdicts.json holds the verdict, check statuses and counts of every tree case. run_mutations.py --golden compares them; a rule change that moves any of them fails CI until the golden file and CHANGELOG.md are updated together.
